A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose and analyze a novel change detection procedure in a network of agents with incomplete information, which minimizes the detection delay while controlling the false alarm rate.

we have developed a new framework for change detection in structured correlated data with incomplete information, which is optimal in the sense that no other algorithm can have a lower average detection delay.

the optimal decision-making process is not a simple sequential procedure, where the agents make decisions independently of each other, but rather it is coupled with the data acquisition process, where the agents can choose the subset of agents that will be observed at each time instant.
